Frequently Asked Questions

Is IBA Karachi better than FAST NUCES?

Both Institute of Business Administration Karachi and FAST National University of Computer & Emerging Sciences are HEC-recognized universities. IBA Karachi is public (est. 1955) in Karachi, while FAST NUCES is private (est. 2000) in Karachi / Lahore / Islamabad / Peshawar / Faisalabad / Multan. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between IBA Karachi and FAST NUCES?

IBA Karachi's fee is approximately Rs. 4.4–5L/sem per semester, while FAST NUCES's is Rs. 1.8–2.2L/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for IBA Karachi and FAST NUCES?

IBA Karachi: 85%+ marks, IBA test. FAST NUCES: Engineering: 60% FSc (Pre-Eng/ICS). Computing & Business: 50% FSc with Maths. Merit ≈ 50% test + 40% FSc + 10% SSC (Engg: 33/50/17)..
